# `operations.CreditUnapplied`

A matured/approved payout could not be delivered, so its credit is held UNAPPLIED rather than disgorged ([ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot 5). The money had nowhere to land (the beneficiary account is closed, dormant-past-revival, or does not exist), so instead of losing it the engine records a NAMED IOU: this amount is owed to this beneficiary under this economic intent, and the source keeps the funds (it stays payout-pending). A CROSS-CUTTING engine-declared event (the same posture as operations.Hold*), declared once in the spine under the synthetic `operations` aggregate_type (event-store §4.3) and folded per family as a no-op (the IOU/escheat ledger is spine-owned). The RESOLUTION key is NOT on this event: it is derived from intent_id by SettlementReferences.DeriveResolutionIntentId when a reapply is attempted, so a late original apply and the resolution collapse to one landing (the double-pay guard, [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) §Idempotency). Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — opaque refs, integer cents, a machine reason code, an input date.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `intent_id` | `string` | The [ADR-PC-043](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-043-intra-engine-settlement-counterparty.md) slot-4 economic-intent id the undeliverable payout belongs to (from SettlementReferences.DeriveIntentId) — the exactly-once axis AND the root the resolution key is derived from. A structural token, never PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `beneficiary_account_ref` | `string` | The opaque beneficiary account the credit was meant to land on — a reference the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `amount_cents` | `long` | The undeliverable amount as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1) — held, never disgorged. |
| `reason` | `string` | The stable machine reason code the credit was undeliverable (e.g. BENEFICIARY_ACCOUNT_CLOSED, BENEFICIARY_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND) — never free-text PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `unapplied_at` | `int` (`date`) | UnappliedAt (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the economic date the credit was recorded unapplied, a command-supplied input, never a clock read ([ADR-PC-023](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-023-temporal-signals-projection-derived.md)). |
